scope: Provider-free Waldo-aligned collaboration and research workspace tools
features: Separate team namespaces; approved Owner/Editor/Viewer roles; email-bound hash-only seven-day private invitations; revocation and role checks on every subsequent request; My/All chat creator filters
Brand context history from activation with CAS-checked restore into a fresh revision
PPTX slide-order text extraction; XLSX visible sheet/cell values with cached-formula disclosures; separately attributed DOCX secondary parts
Editable saved-report/pitch PowerPoint text exports with complete body/source trail, bounded pagination, and existing palette
Optional browser speech dictation, review before send, no auto-send and navigation cleanup
IANA local-time monitor schedules with DST/month-end/coalescing rules; legacy UTC and managed weekly behavior preserved
Pitch revision-specific team reviews/owner decisions; full context snapshots for new revisions; legacy limitations; older revision pagination
Full workflow run history, full project report links, project created-since and explicitly linked enabled-monitor filters
Active session/device listing with server-only tokens and revocation
Read-only report/profile API key scopes, new-key expiry, atomic 60/min rate budget, rolling 24h counts, full paginated REST/MCP report search

verification.dom: 16 actual Workspace React DOM interactions in Happy DOM; includes owner/viewer controls, voice transcript/no auto-send/cleanup, local viewer filters and combined project filters Legacy invalid timezone initialization was reproduced, fixed with UTC fallback, and regression-tested.

limits: No authenticated live Edge/browser walkthrough or microphone recording claimed. Browser audio recognition was tested through a mocked browser engine; provider support varies.
PowerPoint OOXML and relationships/content are validated; no native PowerPoint visual rendering was available.
No real provider research/email requests were made. Existing auth/scheduler/provider/billing configuration and current website CSS/theme are unchanged.

This is not exhaustive Waldo parity. OCR/scanned images/chart reasoning, fine-grained per-record/privacy/requester controls, external client portals, team paid-plan/email sharing, ownership transfer and retention administration remain unavailable.
Provider datasets, merchant activation and Gmail Testing expiry still require separate inputs; no claims of those being enabled.
